mapper.update: UPDATE T_LH_MOLD_ADJUST_PLAN A SET DEL_FLAG = '1', UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATE_BY = NULL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MES_LH_MOLD_ADJUST_PLAN B WHERE B.DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} AND B.IS_DELETE = 1 AND B.ORDER_NO = A.ORDER_NO)

MERGE INTO T_LH_MOLD_ADJUST_PLAN A USING (SELECT * FROM T_MES_LH_MOLD_ADJUST_PLAN WHERE DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} AND IS_DELETE = 0) B ON (A.ORDER_NO = B.ORDER_NO AND A.DEL_FLAG = '0') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.TYPE = B.TYPE, A.LH_MACHINE_CODE = B.LH_MACHINE_CODE, A.PLAN_DATE = B.PLAN_DATE, A.CHANGE_MOLD_TIME = B.CHANGE_MOLD_TIME, A.MOLD_STATUS = B.MOLD_STATUS, A.AUDIT_STATUS = B.AUDIT_STATUS, A.PROCESS = B.PROCESS, A.EXECUTION_STATUS = B.EXECUTION_STATUS, A.BEGIN_TIME = B.BEGIN_TIME, A.FINISH_TIME = B.FINISH_TIME, A.LEFT_SAP_CODE = B.LEFT_SAP_CODE, A.RIGHT_SAP_CODE = B.RIGHT_SAP_CODE, A.LEFT_EMBRYO_SAP_CODE = B.LEFT_EMBRYO_SAP_CODE, A.RIGHT_EMBRYO_SAP_CODE = B.RIGHT_EMBRYO_SAP_CODE, A.LEFT_SPEC_DESC = B.LEFT_SPEC_DESC, A.RIGHT_SPEC_DESC = B.RIGHT_SPEC_DESC, A.LEFT_BEFORE_SPEC_DESC = B.LEFT_BEFORE_SPEC_DESC, A.RIGHT_BEFORE_SPEC_DESC = B.RIGHT_BEFORE_SPEC_DESC, A.LEFT_EMBRYO_CODE = B.LEFT_EMBRYO_CODE, A.RIGHT_EMBRYO_CODE = B.RIGHT_EMBRYO_CODE, A.LEFT_STREAM = B.LEFT_STREAM, A.RIGHT_STREAM = B.RIGHT_STREAM, A.LEFT_MOLD_INFO = B.LEFT_MOLD_INFO, A.RIGHT_MOLD_INFO = B.RIGHT_MOLD_INFO, A.MOLD_ASSEMBLER = B.MOLD_ASSEMBLER, A.MOLD_ASSEMBLE_TIME = B.MOLD_ASSEMBLE_TIME, A.AUDITOR = B.AUDITOR, A.AUDIT_TIME = B.AUDIT_TIME, A.AUDIT_SUGGEST = B.AUDIT_SUGGEST,
A.REMARK = B.REMARK, A.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.ID, A.ORDER_NO, A.TYPE, A.LH_MACHINE_CODE, A.PLAN_DATE, A.CHANGE_MOLD_TIME, A.MOLD_STATUS, A.AUDIT_STATUS, A.PROCESS, A.EXECUTION_STATUS, A.BEGIN_TIME, A.FINISH_TIME, A.LEFT_SAP_CODE, A.RIGHT_SAP_CODE, A.LEFT_EMBRYO_SAP_CODE, A.RIGHT_EMBRYO_SAP_CODE, A.LEFT_SPEC_DESC, A.RIGHT_SPEC_DESC, A.LEFT_BEFORE_SPEC_DESC, A.RIGHT_BEFORE_SPEC_DESC, A.LEFT_EMBRYO_CODE, A.RIGHT_EMBRYO_CODE, A.LEFT_STREAM, A.RIGHT_STREAM, A.LEFT_MOLD_INFO, A.RIGHT_MOLD_INFO, A.MOLD_ASSEMBLER, A.MOLD_ASSEMBLE_TIME, A.AUDITOR, A.AUDIT_TIME, A.AUDIT_SUGGEST, A.CREATE_TIME, A.DEL_FLAG, A.REMARK) VALUES (SEQ_LH_MOLD_ADJUST_PLAN.NEXTVAL, B.ORDER_NO, B.TYPE, B.LH_MACHINE_CODE, B.PLAN_DATE, B.CHANGE_MOLD_TIME, B.MOLD_STATUS, B.AUDIT_STATUS, B.PROCESS, B.EXECUTION_STATUS, B.BEGIN_TIME, B.FINISH_TIME, B.LEFT_SAP_CODE, B.RIGHT_SAP_CODE, B.LEFT_EMBRYO_SAP_CODE, B.RIGHT_EMBRYO_SAP_CODE, B.LEFT_SPEC_DESC, B.RIGHT_SPEC_DESC, B.LEFT_BEFORE_SPEC_DESC, B.RIGHT_BEFORE_SPEC_DESC, B.LEFT_EMBRYO_CODE, B.RIGHT_EMBRYO_CODE, B.LEFT_STREAM, B.RIGHT_STREAM, B.LEFT_MOLD_INFO, B.RIGHT_MOLD_INFO, B.MOLD_ASSEMBLER, B.MOLD_ASSEMBLE_TIME, B.AUDITOR, B.AUDIT_TIME, B.AUDIT_SUGGEST, SYSDATE, '0', B.REMARK)
